title: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00009:part:1/1
title_original: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 8 (Criteria for Engine Emission Volume of Vehicles)
① Under Article 16 of the Act, a "vehicle corresponding to the standards specified in a decree of the Ministry of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries" refers to a vehicle that meets any of the following items, excluding vehicles that are not the lowest grade as defined in Article 30(1) of the Special Act on Improving Air Quality in Air Quality Control Areas. <Amended June 23, 2023>
1. Vehicles using gasoline as fuel
2. Vehicles using energy corresponding to any of items 1 to 3 of Article 7 as fuel
3. Vehicles with an engine emission volume of less than 1,500cc
② According to Article 16(2) of the Act, the head of the local Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Agency may request the submission of the following documents from relevant agencies or port operators: <Newly established June 23, 2023>
1. Vehicle registration number of a vehicle classified as an access restriction target according to Article 16(1) of the Act (referring to the emission grade of a vehicle as defined in Article 30(1) of the Special Act on Improving Air Quality in Air Quality Control Areas)
2. Vehicles as defined in item 1

3. Records of vehicle entry into port facilities or fishing harbors as defined in Article 2, Paragraph 5 of the "Port Act" (hereinafter referred to as "port facilities") or Article 2, Paragraph 5 of the "Fisheries and Harbor Act" (hereinafter referred to as "fishing harbors")

3. The vehicle registration number, name, date of birth, contact information, and address of the vehicle owner (for legal entities, the name of the company, company registration number, and contact information and address of the office) of the vehicle entering the port facility or fishing harbor as defined in Item 1.
